cohort: 188 adult patients (mean age 43 years, 59.79% female) undergoing various surgical procedures including neurological surgeries, nephrectomy, and lower segment caesarean section.
finding: Merizelle ORC achieved haemostasis in all patients, with 94.68% within 10 minutes, and demonstrated excellent safety with no bleeding-related adverse events, proven infections, or postoperative deaths by 6 months post-surgery.
mod_finding: Lower segment caesarean section was among the most common surgical procedures where Merizelle ORC was applied, contributing to the overall findings of excellent safety and efficacy.
